jurisdiction.name: Lao People's Democratic Republic
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Laos has no AI law or adopted AI strategy yet; the Ministry of Technology and Communications (MTC) leads. A 2025 ministerial decision on digital technology business licenses AI businesses and requires AI safety standards based on ISO/IEC 42001 and related standards, and the 2026-2030 technology and communications development plan sets an AI goal including a national AI strategy, an AI innovation centre and a legal framework for ethical AI. A draft National AI Strategy 2026-2035 was approved in principle by the Government in September 2026 but has not been published; the 2021 digital economy vision names AI among core technologies, and the 2017 Law on Electronic Data Protection applies.
narrative.review_notes: This review was completed on 12 October 2026 and covers national law, government, ministries and regulators. The draft National AI Strategy has not been published and is listed as a lead. Not yet verified from the official text: material on the official gazette and central bank websites.

instruments.official_title: ກົດໝາຍວ່າດ້ວຍການປົກປ້ອງຂໍ້ມູນເອເລັກໂຕຣນິກ (ເລກທີ 25/ສພຊ)
instruments.issuing_authority: National Assembly of the Lao PDR
instruments.current_status: In force. Art. 56: the law takes effect from the date of the presidential promulgation decree and 15 days after its publication in the Official Gazette; the gazette publication date is not stated on the MTC copy, so no commencement date is given. The MTC (the ministry formerly named Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications) administers it.
instruments.summary: Laos's general law on the protection of electronic data, adopted by the National Assembly on 12 May 2017 (Resolution No. 012/NA) and promulgated by Presidential Decree No. 117/PP of 23 June 2017. It sets principles, rules and measures for managing and monitoring the protection of electronic data so that its collection, access, use and disclosure are safe and lawful, protecting the rights and interests of the state, individuals and organisations; it applies to persons, legal entities and organisations and is implemented by the Government. It is the baseline legal framework governing personal and other electronic data used to train and run AI systems in Laos; it contains no AI-specific provisions in the pages reviewed.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Baseline data protection law governing electronic data used in AI systems.

instruments.english_title: Decision on Digital Technology Business Operations (No. 3643/MTC)
instruments.current_status: Signed decision No. 3643/MTC. Art. 56 states it takes effect from a date left blank on the published copy and after publication in the Official Gazette, so no commencement date is given. The handwritten date on page 1 reads 29 September 2025 (the MTC proposal it cites is dated 12/09/2025); confirm the month against a clearer copy.
instruments.summary: Ministerial decision of the Minister of Technology and Communications regulating 14 types of digital technology business in Laos, including 'artificial intelligence business' (art. 5), which it defines in art. 3 as technology enabling computer systems or machines to perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence such as learning, reasoning, problem-solving and decision-making. Art. 24 sets technical and safety standards for AI businesses: conformity with ISO/IEC 42001:2023, ISO/IEC 23053:2022, ISO/IEC 23894:2023 and ISO/IEC 29110, disclosure of the platform and AI model used, correctness and reliability, user documentation, complaint channels, safeguards so the AI system is not used to cause harm to society, and security protections. AI businesses are licensed by the Department of Digital Technology (annex) and a licence fee is set; the decision replaces several 2016-2017 MTC/MPT decisions.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Only Lao legal instrument found with AI-specific obligations: licensing and ISO/IEC-based technical and safety standards for AI businesses.
metadata_gaps: effective_date (left blank on source; gazette publication date unknown)

instruments.english_title: 20-Year National Digital Economy Development Vision (2021-2040), 10-Year National Digital Economy Development Strategy (2021-2030) and 5-Year National Digital Economy Development Plan (2021-2025)
instruments.issuing_authority: Ministry of Technology and Communications (approved by the Government and the National Assembly)
instruments.current_status: Published by MTC (Vientiane, December 2021), with an unofficial English translation also on the MTC page. Its 5-year plan component covered 2021-2025, while the vision and strategy run to 2040 and 2030; a separate resolution approving the vision is on the MTC site.
instruments.summary: Laos's national digital economy vision, strategy and plan, prepared by the Ministry of Technology and Communications with line ministries and incorporated into the 9th National Socio-Economic Development Plan. It identifies artificial intelligence among the core digital technologies (with cloud, cybersecurity, big data, IoT and blockchain) and plans a feasibility study on AI and related technologies and human-resource development in new digital skills including AI and data science. It is the overarching digital policy framework within which the later AI-specific plans sit; it has no standalone AI pillar.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Overarching digital economy strategy that names AI as a priority technology; precursor framework for the draft national AI strategy.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60; mtc.gov.la resets connections intermittently, succeeded on retry): 79-page Lao PDF and 58-page unofficial English PDF downloaded from the MTC digital-economy page; preface and AI passages read via pdftotext; month/year from the English cover (December 2021). instruments.english_title: Fourth Five-Year Technology and Communications Development Plan (2026-2030)
instruments.current_status: Signed version published on the MTC website; the cover is dated Vientiane, 14 July 2026. It plans the national AI strategy whose 2026-2035 draft the Government agreed in principle in September 2026 (see leads).
instruments.summary: The technology and communications sector's five-year plan for 2026-2030, implementing the sector's 10-year strategy and 20-year vision; its overall objective is to build digital government, economy and society 'using artificial intelligence as a key mechanism'. Goal 8 and priority work plan 8 are dedicated to AI: developing a national AI strategy, building an AI Innovation Center and AI Data Center, applying AI in digital public services, raising AI skills, and creating a legal framework and policies to manage and promote ethical AI development. Its project list includes a national AI strategy project, a 'Lao AI' development project, AI data infrastructure powered by clean energy and an AI economic special zone.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Current government plan with a dedicated AI goal; commits MTC to a national AI strategy and an AI legal and ethics framework.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60; mtc.gov.la resets connections intermittently, succeeded on retry): full 93-page PDF (signed version) read via pdftotext; date from the cover page; AI goal 8 and work plan 8 passages read.
